doc: Labels settled by byte-level traces (function programme batches; each record carries its corrections item). Applied by scripts/mapping/sync_decoded_labels.py. Built from the batch workflow results and reviewed per address against existing names -- do not hand-edit casually.

records.name: set_sp_and_jump
records.comment: Class 75 (2): r15 = constant SP, jump to r4.

records.name: boot_block_decision
records.comment: Boot decision. SP:=0xFFFFBFA0; WDT (0x000762: RSTCSR 0x5A1F, TCNT 0, TCSR 0xA53C), HCAN set-up; 0x000598/0x00054A write 0xFFFFBFE4..BFFB and words BFB8/BFBA:=0; byte BFAC:=0; if long 0xFFFFBFFC != 0x5AA5A55A runs the message window 0x0007E0(7); on every exit long 0xFFFFBFFC:=0x5AA5A55A and jumps via 0x000040 (SP 0xFFFFBFA0) to [0x001000]=0x00127C on this ROM.

records.name: boot_msg_window
records.comment: Boot message window: counts (r4 & 0xFFFF) WDT overflow events (TCSR bit 7, polled; 0x000484 services) and returns 1 at once when that is 0; each pass writes byte 0xFFFFBFA8 := (BFEC == 0x55) and takes CAN messages into the ring 0xFFFFB4E0; returns 0 if FF 86 00.. is seen.

records.name: reset_entry
records.comment: Power-on / manual-reset vector target (SP 0xFFFFBFA0 from 0x000004): calls 0x000C20, 0x000C54, then 0x00065C(r4=0,r5=0), which never returns. Writes no RAM itself.

records.name: boot_bsc_sysc_init
records.comment: BCR1:=0x000F, BCR2:=0, WCR:=0x7777, RAMER:=0, byte 0xFFFFBFAD:=0x77, SYSCR2:=0x3C04, ICR:=0, then spins while ICR bit 15 (NMIL) reads 0.

records.name: boot_port_init
records.comment: Stores constants to 43 port words 0xFFFFF720..0xFFFFF778; no RAM access.

records.name: busy_wait_8n_D78
records.comment: Class 76 (2): busy-wait r5 = 0 .. (r4 << 3) (cmp/hs r4,r5: T when r5 >= r4 unsigned); no memory access.

records.name: boot_stage2_entry
records.comment: Stage 2 entry (SP 0xFFFFBFA0): byte [[0x002000]]=0xFFFF204C := 0x77 unless the word is blank; calls 0x0012C0(0).

records.name: boot_stage2
records.comment: Stage 2 (SP 0xFFFFBFA0, saves nothing): word 0xFFFF800C := 0xA53C (class 0), 0x001332 WDT writes, HCAN, longs 0xFFFF809C..80AF; byte 0xFFFF204C := 0x88; 0x001008 loads SP 0xFFFFBF7C and jumps to [0x0FFFF8]=0x00FA34.

records.name: empty_function
records.comment: Class 2 (68 members): rts; nop. No register, flag or memory changes.

records.name: isr_context_save
records.comment: Entered only by the jsr at stub+6 of the 118 interrupt stubs. Pushes r2; [0xFFFF1290] += 1 with SR = [0xFFFF1298] around the update and the entry SR put back after; pushes r3-r7, fr0-fr10, FPSCR, fr11, FPUL (20 longs). Returns r0 = 0x002BD4 (the common exit), which the stub loads into PR before jumping to the handler. Calls and dispatches nothing.

records.name: ISR_CommonEpilogue
records.comment: Common interrupt exit. Pops the 0x002B8C frame and [0xFFFF1290] -= 1. It rtes unless the count, the flag bits and the interrupted SR mask field are all zero, byte [0xFFFF1288] != 0xFF, record byte +1 != 1 and byte [0xFFFF1288] >u the running task byte +1. In that case it saves the full context and jumps to 0x0035FC. With bit 31 set (idle loop interrupted) it abandons the stack and jumps to 0x0035FC.

records.name: sr_mask_raise_return_previous
records.comment: In: r4 = SR value wanted. Out: r0 = SR & 0xF0 on entry. SR := r4 (whole register, & 0x3F3) only when r4 >u (SR & 0xF0), otherwise SR unchanged except T = 0. r5 := 0xF0. No memory access, no stack.

records.name: interrupt_restore
records.comment: In: r4 = SR value (call sites pass back what 0x00317C returned). SR := r4 on every path (delay slots). If r4 == 0 and byte +1 of the record at [0xFFFF12A0] != 1, it tail-jumps to 0x003664, which switches tasks when word [0xFFFF128C] != word [0xFFFF128E] and bit 12 of [0xFFFF1290] is clear, and returns r0 = 0 to the original caller.

records.name: ready_queue_insert
records.comment: r4 = 0xFFFF1288, r5 = id, r6 = index. Queues the id on the ring of that index; if the ring was empty, sets the map bit at 0xFFFF12B8. If index > (int8) byte [0xFFFF1288], it sets that byte := index and word [0xFFFF128E] := id and returns 1; otherwise returns 0. A full ring is not detected.

records.name: kernel_start_entry
records.comment: Returns 0 unless r4 < byte [0x003F1C] = 1 (unsigned). For r4 = 0 it sets SR, SP and KCB+8 := 0x100, then jumps to 0x0036C4 with r4 unchanged (bytes only; ldc sr not emulated).

records.name: context_save_callee_saved
records.comment: Pushes r5 (SR image), pr, a 4-byte gap, r8-r12, gbr, r13, mach, r14, macl and, only when byte @(0,r6) == 4, fr12-fr15; sets byte @(0, long @(4,r6)) := 4 and long @(12,r4) := r15; branches to 0x0034B4. Never saves r0-r7, fr0-fr11, fpul.

records.name: rtos_task_dispatch
records.comment: Task dispatcher: writes word [KCB+4] = id and the [KCB+20]/[KCB+24] record pointers, then starts or resumes the task via 0x003820 or the resume table at 0x004090.

records.name: deferred_task_switch
records.comment: Reached only from 0x0031A0. Saves SR in r13 and loads SR := [0xFFFF1298]. If word [0xFFFF128C] == word [0xFFFF128E], or bit 12 of [0xFFFF1290] is set, it restores SR and returns 0. Otherwise [0xFFFF1290] := 0x100 and it calls the context save 0x003440 (r4 = 0xFFFF1288, r5 = entry SR, r6 = [0xFFFF12A0]); on resume it returns 0.

Per 3-byte item: b0 FF/F2/F4 copies 1/2/4 bytes from 0xFFFF0000|(b1<<8)|b2 with no address bound; otherwise index (sext8(b0)<<16)+(b1<<8)+b2 < 848 unsigned -> getter[index](r4=index)&0xFF, else code 0x12. Reply bytes are stored from 0xFFFFB3F4 through an ...

Reply F8 b3, or 7F B8 code via 0x098686.

records.name: write_whitelist_check
records.comment: r4 = index; r0 = 0 if index == u32[0x09CA0C] (= 0x60), else 1. List length is the immediate 1 at 0x09A712, which is also the not-found result.

records.name: service_record_dispatch
records.comment: r4 = service id, r5 = 16-bit value passed to the handler as r4, r6 low byte selects record table 0x09B88C (0) or 0x09B778 (non-zero). Returns 0 after calling u32[record+4], 1 if the id is absent, 2 if (1 << u8[0xFFFFB450]) & record mask == 0; every mask is 1, so any non-zero mode byte refuses every listed id.

records.name: ring_reset_write_index
records.comment: r4 = channel. Sets the record's write index to mark+1, or 0 when mark >= 600.

records.name: ring_append_bytes
records.comment: Appends count bytes to record 0xFFFFB454+608n at the write index (u16 +0); drops a byte when write index == mark; stores at record+6+zero-extended write index with no range check before the store; wraps at 601.

records.name: ring_read_bytes
records.comment: r4 = channel, r5 = destination, r6 = count. Copies count bytes from record 0xFFFFB454+608n at its read index (u16 +2), wrapping at 601; writes 0 when nothing is unread (read == mark+1, or mark >= 600 and read == 0).

records.name: empty_fn_09CFEA
records.comment: Shape class 2: rts; nop -- empty function Member parameters: . Shape-matched and emulated per member.

records.name: ring_append_if_bound
records.comment: r4 = id, r5 = source, r6 = count. If u8[0xFFFFB6DF] == id, calls 0x09CCF8(0, r5, r6).

records.name: ring_read_if_bound
records.comment: r4 = id, r5 = destination, r6 = count. If u8[0xFFFFB6DF] == id, calls 0x09CD50(0, r5, r6); otherwise the destination is untouched. Only channel 0 is scanned.

records.name: ring_reset_if_bound
records.comment: r4 = id. If u8[0xFFFFB6DF] == id, calls 0x09CC44(0).

records.comment: Class 73 (3): u8[O] = sat8(f32[X] + 40); r0 = same.

records.comment: Class 45 (5): u16[O] = sat16(f32[X]/SC) via 0x0BE5D8; r0 = same.

records.comment: Shape class 45: u16[O] = sat16(f32[X] / SC) and r0 = the same value, i.e. 0x0BE5D8(fr4 = f32[X], fr6 = 0.0, fr5 = f32@SC). Member parameters: X=0xffff63b4 F=0xbe5d8 SC=@0A8890:0.00999999978 (3C23D70A) O=0xffffaf7e. Shape-matched and emulated per member.

records.name: f2u16_653C_to_AF88
records.comment: Shape class 45: u16[O] = sat16(f32[X] / SC) and r0 = the same value, i.e. 0x0BE5D8(fr4 = f32[X], fr6 = 0.0, fr5 = f32@SC). Member parameters: X=0xffff653c F=0xbe5d8 SC=@0A8B80:3.05175781e-05 (38000000) O=0xffffaf88. Shape-matched and emulated per member.

records.comment: Shape class 45: u16[O] = sat16(f32[X] / SC) and r0 = the same value, i.e. 0x0BE5D8(fr4 = f32[X], fr6 = 0.0, fr5 = f32@SC). Member parameters: X=0xffff4130 F=0xbe5d8 SC=@0A93C8:0.000999999931 (3A83126E) O=0xffffaf98. Shape-matched and emulated per member.

records.name: ret2_0A9858
records.comment: Shape class 6: r0 = constant I Member parameters: I=2. Shape-matched and emulated per member.

records.name: rec8_read_float_or_default
records.comment: in r4 = REC8 record, fr4 = default. out fr0 = float at [r4] if CK(V) matches word +4 or +6, else fr4 (bit-exact). Never writes the record; reads V twice inside the mask window (0BDB42/0BDB44 words, 0BDB5C long). SR returned with I as found, M=Q=S=T=0.

records.name: pair8_write
records.comment: in r4 = PAIR8 (word-aligned), r5 = byte. word[r4] = (b<<8)|(~b&0xFF); r0 = 0. Leaf, no mask window, SR untouched.

records.name: pair16_write
records.comment: in r4 = PAIR16 (long-aligned), r5 = word. long[r4] = (w<<16)|(~w&0xFFFF); r0 = 0. Leaf, no mask window, SR untouched.

records.name: rec8_write_long
records.comment: in r4 = REC8 record, r5 = 32-bit value. Inside the mask window stores word +4 = CK, long +0 = value, word +6 = CK (last in the jsr 0x003190 slot). No test of any kind; r0 = 0 always; the record is never read.

records.name: rec8_write_float
records.comment: in r4 = REC8 record, fr4 = float. NaN (fcmp/eq fr4,fr4 T=0) -> r0 = 1, nothing written, no SR load. Else inside the mask window word +4 = CK(bits), float +0 = fr4, word +6 = CK; r0 = 0. No range check; no caller ever reads r0.

records.name: pair8_validate
records.comment: in r4 = PAIR8. out r0 = 0 if byte[+0] == ~byte[+1] & 0xFF else 1. Read-only, masked window, verdict only.

records.name: pair16_validate
records.comment: in r4 = PAIR16. out r0 = 0 if word[+0] == ~word[+2] & 0xFFFF else 1. Read-only, masked window, verdict only.

records.name: rec8_validate_long
records.comment: in r4 = REC8 record. r0 = 0 if CK(V) equals word +4 or +6, and then both check words are rewritten with CK(V); else r0 = 1 and the record is untouched. V read once as a long (0BDC7C). No FP register touched.

records.name: rec8_validate_float
records.comment: Same as 0x0BDC6A but V is moved through fr8 (0BDCC8 fmov.s @r13,fr8). No NaN test. fr8 holds the record float on return only if no context switch happens in 0x003190/0x003664; no caller reads fr8 afterwards.

records.name: u16_saturating_sub
records.comment: r0 = max(u16(r4) - u16(r5), 0). Leaf. No reference anywhere in the ROM.

records.name: u16_weighted_mean
records.comment: a=u16(r4), b=u16(r5), k=u16(r6): k==0 -> b; else a +/- ((|b-a| * (0x10000-k)) >> 16) toward b. MACL saved/restored.

records.name: clamp_s32_x_hi_lo
records.comment: r0 = hi if x >= hi; else x if x > lo; else lo (signed; args x=r4, hi=r5, lo=r6).

records.name: min_u32
records.comment: r0 = unsigned min(r4, r5).

records.name: max_by_u16
records.comment: r0 = r4 if u16(r4) >= u16(r5) else r5; the whole register is returned.

records.name: absdiff_s32
records.comment: r0 = r4 - r5 if r4 > r5 (signed) else r5 - r4.

records.name: step_lookup_u8_by_float_threshold
records.comment: r4 = record {s16 count @+0, float32* thresholds @+4, u8* values @+8}, fr4 = x. Returns in r0 the zero-extended byte paired with the highest-index threshold that is NOT greater than x; values[0] if none or if count <= 0 (values[0] is read before the count is tested). Clobbers r0 r2 r4 r5 r6 r7 fr8; no memory written.

records.name: sat_add_s32
records.comment: r0 = r4 + r5 saturated to signed 32 bits (0x7FFFFFFF on positive overflow, 0x80000000 on negative). Clobbers r0 r5.

records.name: uint8_add_sat
records.comment: r0 = min((r4 & 0xFF) + (r5 & 0xFF), 255). Unsigned, add only; upper 24 input bits ignored. Clobbers r0 r3 r4 r5.

records.name: uint16_add_sat
records.comment: r0 = min((r4 & 0xFFFF) + (r5 & 0xFFFF), 65535). Unsigned, add only; upper 16 input bits ignored. Clobbers r0 r4 r5.

records.name: float_clamp_range
records.comment: fr4 = x, fr5 = LOW, fr6 = HIGH. fr0 = fr5 if not (fr4 > fr5), else fr4 if fr6 > fr4, else fr6 (bit-exact move, no arithmetic). With low > high it returns fr5 for x <= fr5 and fr6 otherwise. Changes only fr0 and fr7. Also entered by a tail jmp at 0x02FA20.

records.name: u8_to_float_scale_offset
records.comment: fr0 = fr4 * (float)(r4 & 0xFF) + fr5 by one fmac (raw = r4 zero-extended, SCALE = fr4, OFFSET = fr5). Clobbers r4 fr0 fr3 fr5 fpul. Final rounding: firmware expects truncation; fused-vs-unfused not established.

records.name: u16_to_float_scale_offset
records.comment: fr0 = fr4 * (float)(r4 & 0xFFFF) + fr5 by one fmac (raw = r4 zero-extended, SCALE = fr4, OFFSET = fr5). Clobbers r4 fr0 fr3 fr5 fpul. Same rounding caveat as 0x0BE588.

records.name: float_to_u8_scale_offset_round_clamp
records.comment: x = fr4, SCALE = fr5 (divisor), OFFSET = fr6 (subtracted first). r0 = clamp(trunc((fr4 - fr6) / fr5 + 0.5), 0, 255). No zero-divisor test. Clobbers r0 r4 r5 fr2 fr3 fr4 fpul.

records.name: float_to_u16_scale_offset_round_clamp
records.comment: x = fr4, SCALE = fr5 (divisor), OFFSET = fr6 (subtracted first). r0 = clamp(trunc((fr4 - fr6) / fr5 + 0.5), 0, 65535). No zero-divisor test. Clobbers r0 r4 r5 fr2 fr3 fr4 fpul.

records.name: float_outside_window
records.comment: x = fr4, CENTRE = fr5, HALF-WIDTH = fr6. r0 = 1 if (fr5 - fr6) > fr4 or fr4 > (fr5 + fr6), else 0: 1 means OUTSIDE, both edges count as inside. Clobbers r0 r4 fr3.

records.name: float_safe_div
records.comment: fr0 = fr4 / fr5; when fr5 == 0 (either sign) it returns +0.0 if fr4 == 0, +FLT_MAX (0x7F7FFFFF) if fr4 > 0, -FLT_MAX otherwise. Clobbers fr0 fr6, and fr3/r0 on the substituted path.

records.name: sat_div_s32_q16
records.comment: Signed r0 = trunc((r4 << 16) / r5) (16.16 quotient) with saturation: r4==0 -> 0; r5==0 -> 0x7FFFFFFF/0x80000000 by sign of r4; integer quotient > 32767 -> 0x7FFFFFFF, < -32768 -> 0x80000000. Guard hole: integer quotient == -32768 with a remainder returns a positive wrapped value. Clobbers r0 r1 r3 r4 r6 r7.

records.name: float_hysteresis_comparator
records.comment: x = fr4, THRESHOLD = fr5, WIDTH = fr6, previous state = r4. r0 = 1 if not (fr5 > fr4); 0 if (fr5 - fr6) > fr4; otherwise r4 returned unchanged and unmasked. Destroys fr5; clobbers r0 r5.

records.name: critical_section_enter
records.comment: r4 = address of a long, r5 = value for SR. Stores SR&0xF0 at @r4 and in r0, then loads SR with r5 if r5 >= SR&0xF0 (unsigned, all 32 bits), else with SR&0xF0. The mask field can be lowered only by an r5 >= 0x100; every resolved caller passes 0x00E0.

records.name: critical_section_exit
records.comment: SR = r4 (the value, not a pointer); r0 not written.

records.name: table_lookup_1D
records.comment: r4 = 1-D record, fr4 = x. fr0 = clamped linear interpolation of the cells, which have the type the byte at +2 selects through the table at 0x0BE860 (0x00 f32, 0x04 u8, 0x08 u16, 0x0C s8, 0x10 s16). Scale (+12) and bias (+16) are applied after interpolating, and only when the typecode is non-zero.

records.name: table1d_lookup_u8_int
records.comment: r4 = 1-D record, fr4 = x. r0 = trunc(interpolation of uint8 cells) & 0xFF. Reads only +0, +4 and +8: no typecode, scale or bias.

records.name: table1d_intaxis_u8
records.comment: r4 = 1-D record whose axis is signed longs, r5 = signed integer input. r0 = integer interpolation of uint8 cells with a 0.32 fraction, & 0xFF. No FPU instruction; MACH/MACL saved.

records.name: table_desc_1d_uint16
records.comment: r4 = 1-D record, fr4 = x. r0 = trunc(interpolation of uint16 cells) & 0xFFFF. No typecode, scale or bias.

records.name: table1d_intaxis_u16
records.comment: r4 = 1-D record whose axis is signed longs, r5 = signed integer input. r0 = integer interpolation of uint16 cells, & 0xFFFF. No FPU instruction; MACH/MACL saved.

records.name: table_lookup_2D
records.comment: r4 = 2-D record, fr4 = axis A input (count at +0, axis pointer at +4), fr5 = axis B input (count at +2, axis pointer at +8). cell(iA,iB) = cells[iB*countA+iA]. fr0 = clamped bilinear interpolation; the typecode at +16 selects the cell type; scale (+20) and bias (+24) are applied unless the typecode is 0. fr4 is destroyed.

records.name: table_desc_2d_uint8_int
records.comment: 2-D record. r0 = trunc(bilinear interpolation of uint8 cells) & 0xFF. Byte +16, +20 and +24 are not read.

records.name: table_lookup_2D_int
records.comment: 2-D record. r0 = trunc(bilinear interpolation of uint16 cells) & 0xFFFF. Byte +16, +20 and +24 are not read.

records.name: float_max
records.comment: fr0 = fr6 = fr4 if fr4 > fr5, else fr5: the larger. Equal inputs or a NaN in either return fr5.

records.name: float_min
records.comment: fr0 = fr6 = fr4 if fr5 > fr4, else fr5: the smaller. Equal inputs or a NaN in either return fr5.

records.name: check_u8_complement_pair
records.comment: r0 = (0xFF - lo - hi) & 0xFF of the 16-bit word at @r4; zero exactly when hi == ~lo. It does not return the stored value.

records.name: check_u16_complement_pair
records.comment: r0 = (0xFFFF - lo16 - hi16) & 0xFFFF of the long at @r4; zero exactly when hi16 == ~lo16.

records.name: uint8_pack
records.comment: r0 = ((r4&0xFF)<<8) | (~r4&0xFF). No memory write.

records.name: int32_fixmul
records.comment: r0 = sat32(floor((s64)r4*(s64)r5 / 65536)); MACH/MACL preserved.

records.name: empty_fn_0BEA3C
records.comment: Shape class 2: rts; nop -- empty function Member parameters: . Shape-matched and emulated per member.

records.name: float_lag_filter
records.comment: fr4 = A, fr5 = B, fr6 = k, fr7 = eps. r = A + (1-k)*(B-A). Returns A when B is Inf/NaN (only fr5 is tested) or when eps > |A-r|; otherwise r. With A = +/-Inf and B finite: NaN for k <= 1, A for k > 1.

records.name: int_lag_coeff256
records.comment: r0 = r4 + trunc((1 - (r6&0xFFFF)/256) * (float(r5) - float(r4))), in single precision. k = 256 returns r4, k = 0 returns r5.

records.name: int_sat_sub
records.comment: r0 = sat32(r4 - r5): 0x7FFFFFFF on positive overflow, 0x80000000 on negative.

records.name: float_abs_diff
records.comment: fr0 = fr4 = |fr4 - fr5|.

records.name: busy_wait_8n
records.comment: Busy-wait: counts r5 from 0 to (8*r4 mod 2^32), 3 instructions per count. No result; r0 untouched. 12 call sites, all constant (2..10000).

records.name: interp_1d_float32
records.comment: r0 = cell index, r1 = data pointer (float32 cells), fr0 = fraction -> fr2 = cell[i] when fr0 == 0.0 (cell[i+1] not read), else cell[i] + fr0*(cell[i+1]-cell[i]) via fsub + fmac. Changes r0, r1, fr2 and (interpolating path) fr1 only; no fpul/mach/macl.

records.name: interp_1d_int8
records.comment: Same contract as 0x0BEACC with SIGNED 8-bit cells (mov.b, no extu), result in raw counts in fr2; also writes fpul (lds r0,fpul). Reachable only via handler-table slot 0x0BE86C and bsr from 0x0BEBF0; no real record uses it.

records.name: interp_1d_int16
records.comment: Same as 0x0BEACC with SIGNED 16-bit cells (mov.w, no extu; index x2), raw counts in fr2, writes fpul. Reachable only via slot 0x0BE870 and bsr from 0x0BEC1C; no real record uses it.

records.name: interp_1d_uint8
records.comment: Same as 0x0BEACC with UNSIGNED 8-bit cells (mov.b + extu.b), raw counts in fr2, writes fpul. Called via slot 0x0BE864 (typecode 0x04), bsr from 0x0BE874 and twice from 0x0BEC4C.

records.name: interp_1d_uint8_int
records.comment: r0 = index, r1 = data (uint8 cells), r2 = unsigned 0.32 fraction -> r0 = d0 when r2 == 0, else d0 + floor((d1-d0)*r2/2^32) if d1 > d0, else d0 - floor((d0-d1)*r2/2^32); truncates toward d0. Changes r0, r1, r3, mach, macl (only r0, r1 when r2 == 0). Only caller: bsr at 0x0BE89C.

records.name: interp_1d_uint16
records.comment: Same as 0x0BEACC with UNSIGNED 16-bit cells (mov.w + extu.w, index x2), raw counts in fr2, writes fpul. Called via slot 0x0BE868 (typecode 0x08), bsr from 0x0BE8AC and twice from 0x0BEC78. Linear between cells, not a step lookup.

records.name: interp_1d_uint16_int
records.comment: Same as 0x0BEB40 with UNSIGNED 16-bit cells (index x2, mov.w + extu.w). Changes r0, r1, r3, mach, macl. Only caller: bsr at 0x0BE8D4; no long in the ROM points at it.

records.name: interp_2d_float32
records.comment: r0 = count0 (run length), r1 = data, r2 = index0, r3 = index1, fr0 = fraction0, fr1 = fraction1 -> fr2 = bilinear value in raw units: interpolate along run index1 with 0x0BEACC, and if fraction1 != 0 also along run index1+1 and blend. cell(i0,i1) at r1 + (i1*count0 + i0)*4 (muls.w, signed 16-bit). Changes r0 r1 r3 fr0 fr1 fr2 fr3 fr4 macl.

records.name: interp_2d_int8
records.comment: 2-D contract of 0x0BEBC0 with signed 8-bit cells (stride count0*1) through 0x0BEAE4; also writes fpul. Reachable only via slot 0x0BE920; no real record uses it.

records.name: interp_2d_int16
records.comment: 2-D contract of 0x0BEBC0 with signed 16-bit cells (stride count0*2) through 0x0BEB00; writes fpul. Reachable only via slot 0x0BE924; no real record uses it.

records.name: interp_2d_uint8
records.comment: 2-D contract of 0x0BEBC0 with uint8 cells (stride count0) through 0x0BEB20; writes fpul. Called via slot 0x0BE918 (typecode 0x04) and bsr from 0x0BE928.

records.name: interp_2d_uint16
records.comment: 2-D contract of 0x0BEBC0 with uint16 cells (stride count0*2) through 0x0BEB6C; writes fpul. Called via slot 0x0BE91C (typecode 0x08) and bsr from 0x0BE944.

records.name: axis_search_f32_linear
records.comment: r0 = count, r1 = float32 axis, fr0 = x -> r0 = index, fr0 = fraction. Linear scan DOWN from axis[count-1]; x >= last (or NaN in the emulator) -> (count-1, 0.0); x < axis[0] -> (0, 0.0); else highest i with axis[i] <= x and fraction (x-axis[i])/(axis[i+1]-axis[i]). No count <= 0 guard: with count 0 it reads below the axis and keeps walking down while the long read is > x. Changes r0 fr0 fr1 (fr2 interior).

records.name: axis_search_i32_linear
records.comment: r0 = count, r1 = INT32 axis, r2 = signed 32-bit x -> r0 = index, r1 = unsigned 0.32 fraction floor((x-axis[i])*2^32/(axis[i+1]-axis[i])) from a div0u + 32 x (rotcl, div1) divide; same top-down linear scan and clamps as 0x0BECA8 with signed compares; no count <= 0 guard. Changes r0 r1 r3 (r2 interior), T/Q/M.

records.name: axis_search_2d_pair
records.comment: r4 = 2-D record, fr4, fr5 -> (r2, fr0) = 0x0BECA8(word[r4+0], long[r4+4], fr4) and (r3, fr1) = 0x0BECA8(word[r4+2], long[r4+8], fr5). No typecode read, no stride computed. Changes r0 r1 r2 r3 fr0 fr1 fr2 fr3.

records.name: launch_offset_inject
records.comment: Tuned only. fr15 += [0x0F1050]=2700.0 when speed<K (byte 0xFFFF65D0==1) or !(speed>K) (otherwise); else [0x0F1054] / [0x0F1048], both 0.0 in 20.19c. fr8=[0x0CC500]; jmp 0x03B6B2. Clobbers r0,r2,fr6,fr8,fr9,T; no memory write; pr untouched (0x03B6A8 on entry, not the caller's return address).

records.name: boot_wdt_limit
records.comment: long; trunc(300/1.6384+0.5)=183 written by 0x010878; compared by 0x010AD8 (0x010AE8)

records.name: boot_wdt_iti_count
records.comment: long; 0 at 0x010878, +1 per WDT ITI taken (0x010AE4); 0..182 at the kernel start, value timing-dependent

records.name: boot_wdt_code_select
records.comment: byte; 0x0108DA's argument (0 at reset); selects expiry code 0x2100/0x2200/0x2300 (0x010AF2)

records.name: rtos_queued_ids
records.comment: On-chip RAM, not an MTU register: the array of queued task ids that [KCB+36] points to.

records.name: rtos_ready_map
records.comment: On-chip RAM, not an SCI register: the 16-byte ready map that 0x0034CC scans and 0x003206 sets.

records.name: keepblock_marker_2000
records.comment: 0xAA55 = warm marker (set by 0x010198 at the end of a cold start); 0x55AA during the cold path (0x01018A).

records.name: boot_handover_byte_204C
records.comment: byte; 0x77 at 0x00128A, 0x88 at 0x001324 (address from ROM long 0x002000)

records.name: trap_log_count
records.comment: Count byte of the five-record trap log at 0xFFFF2064 (stride 12), filled by 0x010800 from 0x00E774 with {code 0x4000, vector number}. Nothing drains it; item 84's 'scheduler event queue' reading is retracted.

records.name: pair16_init_223C
records.comment: u32 set to 0x0000FFFF (value 0 : complement) by 0x024CA0 and 0x024CB0 through 0x0BE9B0. Meaning not established.

records.name: eeprom_outcome_pair_word
records.comment: value:~value word of [7268] (0x01FE / 0x00FF), written by 0x02ED88 and rebuilt by 0x02E8C0 when inconsistent.

records.name: ctl7904_centre_rec
records.comment: Guarded float record (value + two check words) holding the centre of the 0xFFFF7904 window; stepped by 0.0005 in 0x0359A4 and stored through the clamp ROM 0x036000 (lo) .. 0x035FFC (hi), zeroed in every flashed rev. Nothing ties it to a pressure.

records.name: cnt_3694
records.comment: High byte of word 3694/3695: counter incremented on qualifying warm starts, compared with LIM 0xFFFF8EEE by 0x05CB1C.

records.name: startup_reinit_request_word
records.comment: 0x047C40 calls 0x048732 (full re-init including the AFL cell clear) iff this word==0x4055 at its entry with [8EDC]==0. 0x05D070 writes 0x4055 (caller 0x098FE4), 0x05D032 writes 0xAA55. 0x04793C accepts 0x4055 or 0xAA55.

records.name: front_o2_sensor_ma
records.comment: Front O2 sensor current (mA): x of "Front Oxygen Sensor Scaling" (axis pointer 0x0D8D74 = definition axis "Front Oxygen Sensor"); read by 0x058902.

records.name: fbba_arg_5B6C
records.comment: byte; 0x00FBBA's argument, 0 at reset (0x00FA8A)

records.name: reset_ramtest_result
records.comment: byte; 1 = range A failed, else 8*B_fail + 2*C_fail (0x010352)

records.name: startup_status_5B8D
records.comment: Zeroed by 0x0100E4. 0x010124 sets 1 when marker 0xFFFF2000 != 0xAA55; 0x01001C stores 0x04793C's result (0 pass / 1 fail).

records.name: plate_change_2calls
records.comment: 0x01F588: [62DC] minus [62DC] from two calls earlier

records.name: ffff4130_lag_filtered
records.comment: Written only (find_writers lower bound) by 0x01FDF2 (bit copy of f32[0xFFFF4130]) and 0x01FDD4 (0x0BEA40 lag toward f32[0xFFFF4130], k = 0.5, eps = 10*2^-15). Same quantity and units as 0xFFFF4130; the label adc_processed_temperature_B is unsupported.

records.name: maf_window_max_snap
records.comment: snapshot of running max [6420] (01FF04)

records.name: maf_window_min_snap
records.comment: snapshot of running min [6424] (01FF0C)

records.name: maf_window_mid_gps
records.comment: ([63B8]+[63BC])*0.5 = (max+min)/2 of [63B4] samples since the previous 0x01FE46 call

records.name: mass_airflow_gps
records.comment: min(window mean * MAF Compensation(IAT) + [69F4]*0x0C3104, MAF Limit 0x0C3100); written at 01FF66

records.name: gps_per_679C_load
records.comment: min([63C4]*60/[679C], Limit A), written only when [679C] > 0.1953125

records.name: gps_per_rpm_load
records.comment: min([63C4]*60/RPM, Limit A), written only when RPM > 0.1953125

records.name: load_comp_blend
records.comment: (1-[90A8])*0x0AB004 + [90A8]*0x0AB020; the maps are byte-identical, so it equals the Cruise value

records.name: load_cell_delta
records.comment: [63F8] new minus entry value, every 0x01FE46 call (020328)

records.name: ffb_641C_threshold
records.comment: f32 written by 0x01FE46 at 01FF8C: 0x0AAE64(RPM) when [65FC] >= 50 else 0x0AAE78(RPM) = 32.0

records.name: latch_set_this_call
records.comment: 1 on a set call, else 0 (01FFEA / 01FFEE)

records.name: latch_hold_enable
records.comment: 1 on every set call; 0 once u8 [6418] >= 13

records.name: lift_latch_641C
records.comment: set by the 0x01FE46 set gate; held/cleared per hold gate; cleared by 0x020678/0x020726; freezes [63F8] against rising

records.name: maf_window_max
records.comment: 0x0203DC: max([6420],[63B4]); restarted at [63B4] by 0x01FE46

records.name: maf_window_min
records.comment: 0x0203DC: min([6424],[63B4]); restarted at [63B4] by 0x01FE46

records.name: factor_AAE3C
records.comment: 0x0AAE3C([6898]), 1.0 flat; also the literal base used in 0x01FE46

records.name: u0_ratio_6458
records.comment: float written by 0x0209DC: 020D7E = max(([0xFFFF44A8]-fr15)/(fr13-fr15)*100, 0) or the old value; 020CFC = U1 on the r11 == 2 branch. Read by 0x039316. Identity not established.

records.name: u1_ratio_645C
records.comment: float written by 0x0209DC: 020DB6 = max(([0xFFFF44AC]-fr12)/([F+28]-fr12)*100, 0) or the old value; 020CEA = 0.0 / 020CF2 = 100.0 on the r11 == 2 branch. Read by 0x039316.

records.name: front_o2_lambda_atm_comp
records.comment: Atmospheric-pressure-compensated front-O2 lambda, clamp(1 + ([8DE4]-1)*T_0x0AAE8C([6898]), 0.75, 2.0) (the definition formula /14.7), or 1.0; written only by 0x021A3C and 0x021D7C (1.0). NOT a sensor voltage.

records.name: front_o2_lambda_lag
records.comment: First-order lag (k = [0x0C3184] = 0.5, 0x0BEA40) of [653C], or a straight copy, or 1.0; written by 0x021A3C / 0x021D7C. No rate limit.

records.name: opt_C303F_not_AA
records.comment: u8 = (ROM byte 0x0C303F == 0xAA) ? 0 : 1, a calibration option; 0x55 in all 20 bins, so always 1. Not an engine-running state. Read by 0x022CF4 (== 1).

records.name: byte_65F6_copy_of_415C
records.comment: 0x022F1C copies byte [415C]; 0x022DB0 zeroes it; ==1 triggers re-seeding in 0x020726/0x0203DC. Identity not established.

records.name: passes_since_crank_67EC
records.comment: u16. 0x023A94 holds it at 0 while byte [726C]==1, else increments it once per 0x04907C main-list pass (saturating). It is the decay gate of [7354] (>38) and [7374] (>0).

records.name: gear_estimate
records.comment: u8 gear estimate 1..5, 6 = none determined. Writer 0x023EB8: [0xFFFF65FC]/([0xFFFF6624]/1000) ladder against the definition tables 'Gear Determination Thresholds A/B/C'. Not an open-loop selector.

records.name: atm_pressure_current
records.comment: Atmospheric pressure: x of "Front Oxygen Sensor Compensation (Atm. Pressure)" (axis pointer 0x0C36F8 = definition axis "Atmospheric Pressure"); read by 0x021A3C.

records.name: gate_69E6
records.comment: Byte F9 of 0x0410D4. Set to 1 by 0x026634 (with 69E4/69E5/69E7). 0x026698 sets it to 0 when [6350]>70.0 or NOT(lut(0x0AAF5C,[6354])>[63D4]). Never set to non-zero there. Physical meaning not established.

records.name: one_plus_afl_x_tbl0AB140
records.comment: 0x02782C: (1+[7878])*[6A30], times [6A34] when bit 7 of [6A53] and bit 5 of [6A52]; the consumer is not decoded.

records.name: flags_6A29_bit5_cleared_by_revlim
records.comment: Bit 5 written by 0x026CF4 only (0x026DE8 or.b #32 / 0x026DEC and.b #223, GBR 0xFFFF6A29): cleared on every pass while b0 == 1. Meaning of the bit not established.

records.name: flag_8CAA_eq1_gbr_base
records.comment: u8 = (u8[0xFFFF8CAA] == 1), written by 0x027D78 (class 100); GBR base of 0x027D86, which reads it at @(0,gbr) and runs 0x027DB8.. only when it is 1. Meaning not established.

records.name: eeprom_owner_token_in_02EB02
records.comment: In 0x02EB02 / 0x02E968: 0 = free, 0xEE written by 0x02EB02 on ready non-aborting passes, 0 at finish. Other sentinels belong to other clients (not established).

records.name: eeprom_writeback_outcome
records.comment: 1 = busy timeout or gave up, 0 = all written (0x02ED88). Kept consistent with word [3154] by 0x02E8C0 (copy if the pair is consistent, else the word is rebuilt).

records.name: crank_stall_flag
records.comment: u8. 1 while [6624] (axis Engine Speed) <= 300 until [6624] > 500 (0x02EF56); also set to 1 by 0x02F83E.

records.name: post_start_seed_multiplier
records.comment: f32 = 0x0AC338([6350]) (flat 1.0) or 1.0, by 0x02F550 / 0x02F85E. Multiplies the [3158]==0 seeds.

records.name: mode0_duration_clamp_copy
records.comment: Written only by 0x02F974 (02F9D2) = 0x02F9E0 clamp. Readers not checked.

records.name: mode0_factor_a
records.comment: 0x02F974: lookup 0x0AC34C at f32 [620C]; used in the mode-0 duration product. Physical meaning not established.

records.name: pulse_lower_clamp
records.comment: f32 lower clamp of all 0x0301E4 outputs: 0.0 if byte [641C]==1 else 300.0 ([0x0CBE08]); sole writer 0x02FF8E (02FFA0), run just before 0x0301E4

records.name: load_x_injector_scaling
records.comment: clamp([63F8]*'Injector Flow Scaling' raw,0,131072), written by 0x030378; multiplies C in 0x0301E4.

records.name: post_start_addend_a
records.comment: f32 CL-side FFB addend = AD594*[7358]*[7364](*[7360]), written by 0x0304BE. Seeded while [726C]==1, decays afterwards. Range [0, 4.53125].

records.name: post_start_a_state
records.comment: f32 seed of [7354] (0x030454 while [726C]==1). Multiplied by 0.8984375 per N calls while [67EC]>38; zero latch.

records.name: post_start_addend_b
records.comment: f32 CL-side FFB addend = P0*[7390]*AD5CC with the shipped tables, written by 0x03082E. Range [0, 1.540802].

records.name: post_start_b_seed_pair_a
records.comment: f32 P0 when [90C1]==0 and [647C]==1. Seeded by 0x03076E, decays linearly in 0x03082E.

records.name: post_start_b_seed_pair_b
records.comment: f32 P0 otherwise. Seeded by 0x03076E, decays linearly in 0x03082E.

records.name: addend_b_decay_threshold
records.comment: u16 = 0x0ACA6C([6354]) = 0, written by 0x03082E.

records.name: ffb_follower_fast
records.comment: f32 lag state of [73B0] written by 0x0312DE (031484); also read by 0x01FE46 to set byte [641C]

records.name: ffb_mult_decay_counter
records.comment: u8, counter of the [73E0]/[73E4] decay in 0x03110C (031248-0312AA); not reset by the seeder 0x030B68

records.name: ffb_hold_word_counter
records.comment: u16 written by 0x030C10: saturating +1 while byte [7C9D] == 1, else 0; read by the 0x0312DE hold test (threshold 0x0ACD48 = 0)

records.name: afc_model_T
records.comment: T = 30.0 / [0xFFFF6624], written by 0x031D88.

records.name: afc_model_L
records.comment: L = min(lookup2D 0x0AD620, 40); trunc(L) is the integer dead-time count Q2.

records.name: afc_model_TAU
records.comment: TAU = lookup2D 0x0AD848 * lookup 0x0AC45C, the divisor of T in Q0/Q4.

records.name: afc_model_W
records.comment: W = 1.9 (constant branch) or lookup 0x0AD864 (table branch), written by 0x031DB4. Second reader 0x06847E not decoded.

records.name: r0_recip_653C_032204
records.comment: R0: 1/[0xFFFF653C] when |[0xFFFF653C]| > 2^-13, else held (0x032308).

records.name: r1_recip_77C8_032204
records.comment: R1 (live config): 1/[0xFFFF77C8] when |.| > 2^-13, else held (0x032338).

records.name: r7_v_history_032204
records.comment: R7: 41 floats 0xFFFF7630..0xFFFF76D3, history of v (R7[0]=R7[1]=v at end of call); zeroed by block Z and 0x031C9C.

records.name: afc_factor_76D4
records.comment: R8: the output of 0x032204's closed loop, clamped to [LO,HI] and then [0.5,1.5]; served as SSM id 0x009 by getter 0x05D2C0. Its physical meaning is not established.

records.name: r13_flag_032204
records.comment: R13 byte: 1 when EN==1, FLAG==1 and R8 outside R10 +- 2^-13; 0 when FLAG==0; 0 from 0x031C9C.

records.name: exp_approx_last_arg
records.comment: 0x03286C stores its argument here whenever x > 0.35, before the table lookup.

records.name: r11_prev_r2_032204
records.comment: R11: = R2 at the end of every 0x032204 call (0x03283C); never written by 0x031C9C.

records.name: r12_prev_r8_032204
records.comment: R12: = R8 at the end of every 0x032204 call (0x032844); 1.0 from 0x031C9C; read by block C as the previous R8.

records.name: afc_model_branch_flag
records.comment: Byte hysteresis flag on [40C8]: 1 at <= 500, 0 above 550, written by 0x031DB4. 0 selects the constant W branch.

records.name: r14_prev_sel_032204
records.comment: R14 byte: = byte [0xFFFF94B3] at the end of every call (0x03284C) and in 0x031C9C (0x031D0E); compared at 0x032502 to latch R9.

records.name: r15_prev_flag_032204
records.comment: R15 byte: = FLAG (F1==1 && F2==0) at the end of every call (0x032850); 0 from 0x031C9C; selects block B vs C.

records.name: afc_lag_1_64_a
records.comment: First-order lag of R8, k = 1/64, clamped to [0.5,1.5], written by 0x03297A; 1.0 from 0x032958 or when byte [7448] != 1.

records.name: afc_lag_1_128
records.comment: First-order lag of R8, k = 1/128, written by 0x03297A; window-tested by 0x034C54 (0.95..1.05).

records.name: afc_hi_bound
records.comment: Upper clamp bound of R8. Writers: 0x032AA8 (1.0), 0x032B5E (0x0AC4C0 lookup) and 0x0330CA (rate-limited, capped).

records.name: afc_lo_bound
records.comment: LO clamp of [76D4] in 0x032204. Written on every gated 0x032E28 call (03302E/033072/033178) and by 0x032AA8.

records.name: afc_40C8_copy
records.comment: Copy of [40C8], made by 0x032B10 (032B48); the input of lookups AC4C0/AC4D4.

records.name: afc_hi_track_target
records.comment: clamp(x+K,0.5,1.5), K from 1/[77C8]; written by 0x0330CA (MODE 17/19).

records.name: afc_lo_track_target
records.comment: clamp(BASE+K,0.5,1.5); written by 0x033128 (TRACK).

records.name: afc_bound_cap
records.comment: CAP = clamp(1/((1+[7BE4])*[772C]), 0.5, 1.5), written by 0x0331C6; used as the min for HI/LO in 0x0330CA/0x033128.

records.name: afc_bound_mode_counter
records.comment: Byte down-counter in 0x032B5E. Reloaded to 1 in MODE 5/21; forces MODE 8 while nonzero.

records.name: afc_bound_prev_event
records.comment: Byte: the previous call's CUR (byte [98F4]); written last by 0x032B5E.

records.name: cl_lambda_target
records.comment: Closed-loop target in lambda units, written by 0x033460: clamp(clamp(1 + CL Fueling Target Compensation terms (AFR points/14.7) + [7904] + ..., 0.85, [7BDC]), 0.75, 1.25); [7BDC] <= 1.05 in this cal. Read only inside 0x033460.

records.name: cl_lambda_target_out
records.comment: What other routines read of the CL target (lambda units): = [77BC] on 0x033460 COPY/COPY2, a ramp toward it on STEP, [77C0] on SPECIAL (1.0, or 1.20 at standstill with byte [85D7]==1). In [0.75,1.25]. Path to the injector pulse not traced.

records.name: special_blend_factor
records.comment: 0x0340A0: a 0..1 ramp (+-[0x0CBFF8]/[0x0CBFFC] = 10 per call) that rises while byte [85D7]==1 and [65FC] < [0x0CBFF4]=4.0. Set to 1.0 by the 0x0332A2 reset.

records.name: special_exit_blend
records.comment: Written by 0x0340A0 (03427C/034284) and the 0x0332A2 reset. Equals (1-[780C])*[7808] + [7804]*[780C]; read only by the 0x033460 SPECIAL exit (0335AC). 0.0 or 0.20001221 in 20.19c/stock. Physical meaning not established.

records.name: copy_of_7D68
records.comment: f32 copied from [7D68] by 0x03452A (034586) before bsr 0x034CC8

records.name: afc_lag_window_countdown
records.comment: Decremented by 0x034C54 when non-zero and 0.95 < [7708] < 1.05 (with bytes [7448] == 1 and [7453] == 1); zeroed when byte [789E] reaches cal 0x0CBBEE. Its setter is not traced.

records.name: afl_window_samples
records.comment: Sample count of the current AFL window. Incremented at 0x034A44-0x034A4E, cleared at 0x034AFE. Not reset by a change of [787F].

records.name: afl_window_votes
records.comment: Vote counter of the current window: reset to 128 at 0x034B06, +1 when e>=1.01, -1 when e<0.99.

records.name: afl_gate_byte_7883
records.comment: byte written by 0x0345A4 second body: 1 iff nine terms incl. [7324] > [733C]; meaning in 0x03452A not established

records.name: afl_gate_g1
records.comment: Conjunction written by 0x0347F0 body at 0x03487A; read by 0x034884 and 0x071B58.

records.name: afl_7878_lagging_flag
records.comment: 1 while 0x034B1C lags [7878] toward the cell, 0 on a snap (0x034B70). Read by 0x03CD4A and 0x03CFDA.

records.name: afl_g2_consecutive_7884
records.comment: Consecutive passes with [7884]==1, saturating (0x0348E2-0x0348F0). G2 needs >=63.

records.name: cl_target_trim_7904
records.comment: Output of the windowed PI controller 0x0355B8, added with weight +1 into the CL lambda target [77BC] by 0x033460: positive = higher target lambda (leaner by the definitions' AFR convention). Pinned at 0 in every flashed rev (0x0357C8/CC and 0x035FFC/6000 zeroed). Reaches [77C8] only while byte [8E7E] != 1 or byte [9720] != 0. Open-holes #9.

records.name: ol_target_multiplier
records.comment: f32 = 0x0AD0DC([6350]) in [0,1]; only writer 0x036962. Scales [7990] in 0x03606C.

records.name: cl_ol_delay_counter_copy
records.comment: u16 counter (mov.w only, 0x036322). Not read by 0x03606C.

records.name: cl_ol_delay_counter
records.comment: u16. Counts calls while the 0x036978 test fails. 0x03606C compares it with [79C4].

records.name: gate_79C8
records.comment: 0x036322 036428: 1 iff 0 < [79C2] < [79C4]; only writer found.

records.name: per_cyl_addend_0
records.comment: f32 array [7A78+4i], i=0..3, written by 0x037710; zeroed by 0x03757E. Enters [7310+4i] only.

records.name: per_cyl_addend_cap_0
records.comment: f32 array: the upper clamp of [7A78+4i], 1.0 or max(old-0.025, 0.19999999).

records.name: per_cyl_counter_gate_7AA0
records.comment: u8, set by 0x037604 from eleven tests; zeroed by 0x03757E.

records.name: prev_895C
records.comment: f32 [895C] as saved by the previous 0x037604 run, or by 0x03757E.

records.name: stable_895C_pass_count
records.comment: u8. Passes of 0x04907C with the latest [7AB1]==1, saturating at 255 (0x0376EC). Cleared by 0x037604 when its test fails.

records.name: stable_895C_flag
records.comment: u8 (|[895C]-[7AAC]| < 100), written by 0x037604; zeroed by 0x03757E.

records.name: fn382C2_x_out
records.comment: f32 output of 0x0382C2: clamp(A_ACC+B_ACC[*RAMP], LO, HI) when EN==1, else dead band/decay; +0.0 on FORCE0. Read by 0x02FFE0 at 0x03004A. Physical meaning not established.

records.name: fn382C2_ofs
records.comment: f32 subtrahend of DIFF. Only writer found: 0x03817C at 0x03828E ([895C] - K364, only when EN==1).

records.name: fn382C2_lo
records.comment: f32 lower clamp bound = tbl_AC6AC(8*[67EC]) * tbl_AC6C0([6350]), written at 0x038762 when EN==1 and not FORCE0

records.name: fn382C2_hi
records.comment: f32 upper clamp bound = tbl_AC6D4(8*[67EC]) * tbl_AC6E8([6350]), written at 0x03876C

records.name: fn382C2_diff
records.comment: f32 [6624] - [7AF8], written every call at 0x038326

records.name: fn382C2_acc_a
records.comment: f32 accumulator A: seeded min(X_OUT,0); negated-strict windup; zeroed when EN!=1 or by the K370/[647D] gate

records.name: fn382C2_acc_b
records.comment: f32 accumulator B: seeded max(X_OUT,0); windup set = max(cand,0); zeroed when EN!=1

records.name: fn382C2_ramp
records.comment: f32 ramp factor: (1>RAMP) ? min(min(RAMP,t)+K37C,1) : t, with t = tbl_AC698(Q3); 1.0 after reset 0x038860

records.name: fn382C2_enable
records.comment: u8 enable. Only writer found: 0x03817C at 0x03827E, which always writes 0 on shipped cals (K_C7A = K_C7C = 0)

records.name: fn382C2_cnt16
records.comment: u16 count of 0x03817C calls with [65C0] unchanged (0x0382A6); 0xFFFF from 0x038158

records.name: fn382C2_cnt8
records.comment: u8 saturating counter, zeroed when [726C] != 0 (0x038632 / 0x03869A)

records.name: fn3817C_latch_a
records.comment: u8 latch: 0 when [6254]!=1, 1 on a strict window around [895C] +- K350, else unwritten; with K350=0 only 0x038158 sets 1. EN precondition.

records.name: fn3817C_latch_b
records.comment: u8 latch: 0 when [726C]!=0, 1 when [6624] > [895C], else unwritten; 0x038158 writes 0. EN precondition.

records.name: fn382C2_prev_en
records.comment: u8 copy of EN made at the end of each call (0x038846) and by the reset (0x0388B0)

records.name: blk7B7C_state_A
records.comment: float. Seeded by EVENT 7 from 0x0AC710(X0), zeroed by EVENT 5, held 4 calls then decayed by 0x03949E (store 039224). Weights O1 via aL/aE. Physical meaning not established.

records.name: blk7B7C_state_C
records.comment: float. Seeded by EVENT 7 from 0x0AC724(X0), zeroed by EVENT 5, held 8 calls (counter N0) then decayed (store 039262). Weights O1 via cL/cE*M.

records.name: blk7B7C_state_B
records.comment: float. Seeded by EVENT 5 from 0x0AC738 (all zero in 20.19c), zeroed by EVENT 7, hold 0 (store 039244). Weights O2.

records.name: blk7B7C_state_D
records.comment: float. Seeded by EVENT 3 from 0x0AC74C(X0), zeroed by EVENTS 7 and 5, hold 0 (store 039282). Weights O2 via dL/dE*M.

records.name: blk7B7C_sum_S
records.comment: float, S = O1 + O2 stored at 0391D0. Zeroed by 0x0392C4. Read by 0x02FFE0 at 02FFFA and added at 03004E. Bounded to <= +0.046875 with stock tables from a zero start.

records.name: blk7B7C_out_O1
records.comment: float = clamp(C*cL*cE*M + A*aL*aE, lo1, hi1), store 03918E

records.name: blk7B7C_out_O2
records.comment: float = clamp(D*dL*dE*M + B*bL*bE, lo2, hi2), store 0391C2; hi2 = 0.0, so it is never positive

records.name: blk7B7C_mult_M
records.comment: float = ((P-1)*K_P+1)*((Q-1)*K_Q+1), stored every call at 038ED4; 1.0 with stock K = 0.0, NaN for non-finite P or Q

records.name: blk7B7C_count_N0
records.comment: u8 saturating counter, +1 per main-path call, 0 on EVENT 7, 0xFF on reset. Holds A (4) and C (8).

records.name: blk7B7C_count_N1
records.comment: u8 counter, 0 on EVENT 5, holds B

records.name: blk7B7C_count_N2
records.comment: u8 counter, 0 on EVENT 3, holds D

records.name: blk7B7C_flags_F0
records.comment: byte. Bits 7/5/3 are hysteresis bits from U0 (0x039316); bits 6/4/2 are last call's 7/5/3 (0x0393EA); bit1 is the initialised flag (038EB0 or.b, cleared by 0x0392A4).

records.name: blk7B7C_flags_F1
records.comment: byte. Bits 7/5/3 are hysteresis bits from U1; bits 6/4/2 are their previous copy.

records.name: b_cl_exit_copy2_select
records.comment: Byte written only by 0x039E6E (039F14 = 0, 039F28 = 1). It picks COPY2 over SPECIAL in 0x033460 and P3 in 0x039F42 when byte [8E7E]==1. It is 0 after every call in 20.19c/stock because [0x0CC488]=0.0 > [653C] never holds.

records.name: any_cut_byte
records.comment: 0x03AAA4: 1 iff any of eleven cut bytes incl. [7C9D] == 1.

records.name: resume_band_7C6C
records.comment: f32 [7C70] + [7C74]; writer 03AE3A; read by 0x015672 added to [7C78]

records.name: resume_latch_7C70
records.comment: f32 200.0 / 1000.0 latch; writers 03AD50, 03AD64, 03AD72, 03AE0C

records.name: resume_threshold_7C78
records.comment: f32 lookup(0x0AD40C,[6350]) + [895C] + [7C7C], rpm units (compared with [6624]); only writer 03AD06

records.name: resume_adder_sum_7C7C
records.comment: f32 sum of gated adders 300/1100/1000/600/0; writer 03ACF2

records.name: ladder_alt_base_7C80
records.comment: u16 alternate base 250 (03B332) or 0 (03B2F8), else kept; M = max([7C8C], [7C80])

records.name: counter_7C82
records.comment: u16 0 if [7C9E]==1, 0xFFFF if [85D7]==0, else saturating +1 (03AD24); initialised 0xFFFF by 0x03AB60

records.name: ladder_add1_7C84
records.comment: u16 add 625 or 0 (03B228 / 03B2DA); [7C86]/[7C88]/[7C8A] are adds 2-4, written together

records.name: ladder_base_count_7C8C
records.comment: u16 base count of 0x03AF88, state; only real writer 03B218 (section 1); read 03AFE0, 03B33A

records.name: ladder_ext1_7C8E
records.comment: u16 ext1 of 0x03AF88 (section 1 stores, e.g. 03B0AC); feeds output 2

records.name: ladder_ext2_7C90
records.comment: u16 ext2 of 0x03AF88; feeds outputs 3 and 4

records.name: overrun_dwell_threshold_1
records.comment: u16 output 1 = sat16(M + [7C84]) written 03B374; compared with [7CAA] by 0x03AE6C (03AF32) and by 0x03AF88 section 2 (03B304) on the next call; initialised 0xFFFF by 0x03AB60

records.name: ladder_rung4_7C98
records.comment: u16 output 4 written 03B3BE; equals [7C96] (03B3B2) whenever section 1 has run

records.name: overrun_cut_tier
records.comment: u8 tier 0/1/2/4 (3 is unreachable). Written only by 0x03AE6C. Read by 0x041BE4, which saves it to [8034] for its next run.

records.name: ladder_add_flag_7C9B
records.comment: u8 1 when the 625 adds are loaded (03B240), 0 when cleared (03B2EC)

records.name: ladder_alt_flag_7C9C
records.comment: u8 alternate flag: 1 at 03B336, 0 at 03B2FA / 03B30A

records.name: overrun_count_active
records.comment: u8, 1 on the COUNT and IMMEDIATE paths of 0x03B3DA, otherwise 0. It freezes 0x03AF88's section 1 and lets 0x03AE6C produce a tier.

records.name: edge_timer_idle_7CA1
records.comment: u8 0 while the 88-call [65C0]-edge timer runs, else 1; gates the 1000 adder

records.name: counter_window_7CA2
records.comment: u8 1 iff 0 < [7C82] < 188 (03AD42); gates the 1000 term of [7C74]

records.name: overrun_rpm_window_flag
records.comment: u8 window flag, first rule that holds: !([7C78]+[7C6C] > x) -> 1; [7C78] > x -> 0; else [7C9E]==1. Writer 03B46A.

records.name: edge_timer_count_7CA8
records.comment: u16 timer count 0..88 (03AC14, 03AC3C, 03AC46)

records.name: overrun_cut_count
records.comment: u16 count of consecutive COUNT-path passes of 0x03AE5A. Writers are 0x03B3DA (03B5EC +1, 03B5FC/03B610 = 0, 03B544 = [7C98] on the IMMEDIATE path). Read by 0x03AE6C and 0x03AF88.

records.name: countdown_65BF_7CB0
records.comment: u16 loaded 31 on a [65BF] falling edge, -1 per call to 0 (03AC6A, 03AC76)

records.name: run_65D0_eq1
records.comment: u16 run length of [65D0]==1, updated every call of 0x03AE6C (03AEA4). Used by the second tier-4 route.

records.name: edge_timer_active_7CB4
records.comment: u8 timer running flag (03AC10, 03AC50); also the literal base r12 of the 0x03AB94 float stores

records.name: hist_65C0_7CB5
records.comment: u8 previous-call copy of [65C0] (03AC58; initialised by 0x03AB60)

records.name: hist_65BF_7CB6
records.comment: u8 previous-call copy of [65BF] (03AC7A; initialised by 0x03AB60)

records.name: revlim_latch_b0
records.comment: Latch: :=1 when the selected hysteresis byte ==1; :=0 when not and [0x0CC518] > f32[0xFFFF620C]; else held. Read by 0x03D2FC (forces 0xFFFF7D80 = 0xFFFF), 0x03AAA4, 0x03B76E (-> 0x026CF4 clears bit 5 of 0xFFFF6A29). Not updated or reset while int8[0xFFFF8EDC] != 0.

records.name: revlim_hyst_b1
records.comment: Hysteresis byte: :=1 when !([cut] > x), :=0 when [resume] > x, else held; cut/resume = 0x0CC500/0x0CC504 (tuned always; stock outside |spd|<=1). Written 0x03B6CA/0x03B6D4, cleared 0x03B75E; read only at 0x03B71E.

records.name: revlim_hyst_b2
records.comment: Same rule with 0x0CC510/0x0CC514 on the same (tuned: offset) x. Written 0x03B6E4/0x03B6F2, cleared 0x03B760; read only at 0x03B71A.

records.name: ratio_7D58
records.comment: f32 written by 0x03D0B8 (clamp([7324]/[7338]-[7878]-[7AE4],0,2) / 2.0 / 1.0); initialised to 1.0 by 0x03CD00 together with [7D5C..7D64]

records.name: fn_03CD4A_out
records.comment: f32 = 0x03D23A([7D5C],[7D64],[7D68],stack byte) written at 03CF54; 0x03D23A not decoded

records.name: channel_suppress_mask
records.comment: Word written only by 0x03D2FC (0x03D44C): 0xFFFF if any of six bytes (7CB8 among them) ==1, else bits 0..3 from four flag groups; bit k set makes 0x03DCB6 return at once for channel k. Physical channel type not established.

records.name: sched_duration_scale_1p0
records.comment: Constant 1.0 written by 0x03D68C every task-5 pass before 0x03D856.

records.name: sched_records_4x40
records.comment: Four 40-byte channel records; the layout is in the file's RAM LAYOUT. Pads +13..15, +18, +19, +37..39 are never written.

records.name: sched_event_count_u16
records.comment: S+0: saturating +1 each time a record is counted (0x03DA9E / 0x03D930). Zeroed by 0x03D708, the init path and 0x03DBFC.

records.name: sched_mode0_fire_count_s32
records.comment: S+4: saturating +1 per 0x03E168 call that reached 0x009A72 (0x03DD32). Zeroed by 0x03D708, the init path and 0x03DBFC. Read by 0x02F974, where it has no effect, and by 0x02EF56 (not checked).

records.name: sched_fired_flag
records.comment: S+8: set to 1 by 0x03DD46, from 0x03E168 on calls that reached 0x009A72 and from 0x03DFC8 unless rec+7 != 0. Zeroed by 0x03D708 and 0x03DBFC, not by the init path.

records.name: sched_saved_mode_index
records.comment: S+9: 0 or 2. Written by 0x03D856 at 0x03D99E and by 0x03DB16 at 0x03DB4A.

records.name: sched_saved_mask
records.comment: S+10: copy of word [7D80]. Written by 0x03D856 at 0x03D9BA and by 0x03DB16 at 0x03DB4E.

records.name: sched_last_step_byte
records.comment: S+12: the unreduced r4&0xFF of the last 0x03D856 call (0x03D880). Read by 0x03DD4E.

records.name: sched_init_request
records.comment: S+13: 1 makes the next 0x03D856 call take the init path. Set by 0x03D708 and 0x03DBF4; cleared at 0x03D8A2.

records.name: timing_cell_slot0_clamped
records.comment: 0x03F368 03F9FA: clamp(clamp(clamp(S0,-20,[7EC0]),-20,[7EC4]) - [7EC8], [7EE4], 69.65); SSM id 0x11 reports it.

records.name: out_03F368_7EA0
records.comment: first of four floats [7EA0..7EAC] written by 0x03F368 at 0x03FA38..0x03FA6E = clamp([81DC..81E8] + ([7F0C]+[7F68]+[7F6C]-[7FBC]), -20, 69.65) when [0D2976]==90. Meaning not established.

records.name: timing_cap_A
records.comment: 0x03F00C: 69.65 (OFF) / [7ECC] (LOAD while latch [7F09]) / +0.7 ramp.

records.name: timing_subtrahend
records.comment: 0x03F00C: 0x0ADB10([620C]) on rising edge of [7EED], held while 1, -100/call to 0 while 0.

records.name: timing_floor
records.comment: 0x03F00C: -20.0 on every path with shipped tables.

records.name: cap_A_latch
records.comment: 0x03F00C: set on falling edge of [85D7], cleared only on the OFF branch (03F160).

records.name: blend_out_sum_term0
records.comment: 0x04004A tail: k*[7F48] + (1-k)*[7F18] or [7F48]; first term of the sum.

records.name: blend_weight_k
records.comment: 0x03FBBC: steps 0.0156/call toward 0 while [85D7]==1, toward 1 otherwise.

records.name: bound_factor_7FB0
records.comment: Float factor of H. Lag or copy of [7FB4]; equal to [7FB4] in both bins.

records.name: bound_sel_7FB4
records.comment: Float. One of 17 uint8 records at [6624]: 20.0390625 iff byte [3158]==1 or byte [90BE]==1, else 0.

records.name: bound_taper_7FB8
records.comment: Float factor of H. Table 0x0ADD90/0x0ADDA4 at [6354]: 100 at <=30, 75 at >=70.

records.name: integ_7FBC
records.comment: Float integrator written by 0x0410D4. It is clamped to [+0, H] on update paths, and forced to +0.0 while latch [7FF4]==1.

records.name: integ_7FBC_hi
records.comment: Float clamp bound H = [7FB8]*[7FB0]*[7FC4]*[7FD4]*0.01 (times 0.0 if byte [67FC]==1), written by 0x041030.

records.name: bound_factor_7FD4
records.comment: Float factor of H. +0.0 iff byte [9707]!=0, else 1.0. 0x04092A seeds it to 1.0.

records.name: flag_7FDC
records.comment: byte written every pass by 0x040A9C (0x040AF4) from u16 window tests against [0D29C2]/[0D29C4]; cleared by 0x040970. Never 1 in stock.

records.name: count_7FE6
records.comment: u16. Zeroed with [7FED]:=1 on the M entry edge (0x0409C0 and 0x040AF6); counted +1 (sat) by 0x0409C0.

records.name: winB_count_7FEA
records.comment: u16. Set to 0 with [7FEF]:=1, counted +1 (sat) per 0x0409C0 call, set to 0xFFFF on [726C]==1. [7FDC]=1 while <[0x0D29C4] (438 in 20.19c, 0 stock).

records.name: winB_arm_7FEF
records.comment: Byte set to 1 by 0x0409C0 on a 0->1 edge of byte [85D7] (with [726C]!=1); cleared on [726C]==1. Read by 0x040A9C for [7FDC].

records.name: prev_M_7FF0
records.comment: Byte. Set to byte [8970] by 0x0409C0 every call, and to 1 by 0x04092A. Read by 0x040AF6 and 0x0409C0 for the M in {4,7,8} entry edge.

records.name: integ_7FBC_latch
records.comment: Byte. Set to 1 at 0x0411F6 when byte [69E6]==0 and |[7FBC]|<=0.001373291015625 (or NaN). While 1, [7FBC]=+0.0 every call. find_writers reports no clearing store.

records.name: ramp_out_8000
records.comment: float max(R' - max([8258]-[81EC],0), 0) written every call by 0x0415B8 (0x0417DA), zeroed by 0x0418FC; read by 0x03F368 only on its two sum paths.

records.name: ramp_state_8004
records.comment: float ramp state R' of 0x0415B8 (0x0417CC), zeroed by 0x0418FC (0x04191E).

records.name: ramp_gain_8008
records.comment: float multiplier of 0x0415B8 states 1/2; 1.0 from 0x0418AC (flat float32 table 0x0AE164) and 0x0418FC.

records.name: ramp_state_id
records.comment: byte state number 0..5 of 0x0415B8 (0x0417DE).

records.name: ramp_counter
records.comment: byte action counter of 0x0415B8 (0x0417E4), compared with divider [0D297E].

records.name: cut_exit_retard_state
records.comment: 0x041BE4: table 0x0ADE08([6350]) on each armed call, else min(+0.7, 0), reset to 0; always <= 0.

records.name: cut_exit_retard_term
records.comment: = min([8020],[8024]) written every call by 0x041BE4 (041D0E); added into the 0x03F368 sum only on the sixteen-term path (03F644).

records.name: prev_overrun_tier_041BE4
records.comment: u8 copy of [7C9A] stored at the end of every 0x041BE4 run (041D12) and tested by the next run's arm (041C2A). 0x041954 also writes it when 0x022F92 returns 1.

records.name: timing_term_805C
records.comment: f32 output of 0x042506 (GBR base of its struct). Zero or negative only (to about -30.7 in this calibration); summed into total timing at 0x03F656. Gear-, rpm- and step-indexed; what it compensates is not established.

records.name: flags16_8080
records.comment: u16 flag word; bits 0x1000/0x2000/0x4000 select 0x042506's output path. Stored at twelve sites in 0x04209A, 0x042368 and 0x041EEE (three through a stack-held base find_writers.py misses). No knock quantity read.

records.name: term_80B4_80B4
records.comment: 0x042ED8: converges to 0.0 from any start; sum term.

records.name: load_lag
records.comment: 0x044DB0: first-order lag of [63F8] (0x0BEA40, k = [0x0D2E18] = 0.03125, snap 2^-14).

records.name: load_minus_lag
records.comment: 0x044DB0: [63F8] - lag([63F8]) with k = 0.03125. G11/G12 compare it with 0xBDCCCCCC/0x3DCCCCCC.

records.name: fbkc_81F0_saved
records.comment: 0x04581A: [81F0] saved while [824C] == 1. Restored into [81F0] when [824C] != 1.

records.name: cnt_since_79C8
records.comment: 0x044CEA: 0 when [79C8] == 1, else +1 (saturating 255). 0x044300 sets it to 255 at init.

records.name: fbkc_step_enable
records.comment: Written only by 0x0448F4 at 0x044CCA (0 or 1). 0x04438C needs it == 1 for blocks A/B/C/main. 0x02487C packs it into bit 6 of [6893].

records.name: fbkc_rpm_hi_ok_copy
records.comment: 0x04581A: 1 iff [824C] == 1. The value 0 selects head exit 7 ([81F0] = [81FC]).

records.name: cnt_5BE2_set
records.comment: 0x044D12: u16 count of calls while [5BE2] != 0 (saturating), else 0.

records.name: cnt_798C_pos
records.comment: 0x044D12: counts up while [798C] > 0 (saturating 255), else 0. 0x044B1A also clears it.

records.name: fbkc_load_below_min
records.comment: 0x0456E0: 1 when load < 0.95, 0 when load >= 1.0 (20.19c; stock 0.75/0x3F4CCCCC). FBKC head exit 4.

records.name: rpm_below_fine_lo_hyst
records.comment: 0x0457D2: 1 when RPM < 1500, 0 when RPM >= 1600, held in between.

records.name: v79A8_ge_10000
records.comment: 0x0457F4: written every call as shipped. Only reader is the 0x0448F4 tail, which is dead (0x0D299A = 0).

records.name: kc_adv_max_blended_8258
records.comment: 0x045970: (1-[90A8]) T(KC Advance Max Cruise) + [90A8] T(Non-Cruise). Overwritten every call.

records.name: kc_gain_0AE664
records.comment: 0x045970: T(0x0AE664), an all-zero table, so 0.0 every call as shipped.

records.name: rough_corr_window_ok
records.comment: 0x045A3E: AND of [8287..828A], set by 0x045F9A on the Rough Correction Range constants (tuned).

records.name: fine_corr_window_ok
records.comment: 0x0467AE: AND of [82AD..82B0], set by 0x046A4A on the Fine Correction Range constants.

records.name: r04907C_pass_counter_8320
records.comment: With gate 0xFF, 0x04907C adds 1 per call and makes its five calls when the low nibble is 0.

records.name: guarded_float_rec_85DC
records.comment: 8-byte guarded float record (value + two check words ~(hi16+lo16)), written through 0x0BDBCC. Not a byte. What the float means is not established.

records.name: front_o2_lambda
records.comment: Front O2 sensor lambda = table 0x0AF468 ("Front Oxygen Sensor Scaling", AFR = 14.7x) at x = [0xFFFF40E0] (axis "Front Oxygen Sensor", mA); written by 0x058902 (058916).

records.name: request_inhibit_8E65
records.comment: Written only by 0x05A066 (0x05A17E); r5 of 0x05A498 needs it 0.

records.name: latch_8E66_set_only
records.comment: Set to 1 only by 0x05A218 (0x05A252) when [A733] or [A734]==1 and [8E3E]-[3660]<=78; never cleared by a resolved store; ==1 with [A733]=[A734]=0 forces [8E65]=1 (blocks BOTH). Physical meaning not established.

records.name: request_inhibit_8E68
records.comment: Written only by 0x05A26E (0x05A3D2/0x05A3DA); 1 whenever [225C]==0; r5 needs it 0.

records.name: flag_8E69
records.comment: Written only by 0x05A26E (0x05A3DE); 1 only on its rules 10/11; read by 0x039F42 and 0x02538C.

records.name: edge_flag_8E7C
records.comment: 0x05A26E: 0 when [8E46]==0; 1 on a rising edge of [8E65] with [365C]>=3125 or [3664]>=1.

records.name: V_word_8ECC
records.comment: V in {0,1} as a value:~value word, written only by 0x05B690; shadow at 0xFFFF8EF6.

records.name: gate_8EDC
records.comment: High byte of word 8EDC/8EDD (value:~value). 0x05CB1C writes 00/A5/FF at most once per reset (warm start only); otherwise the byte holds post-reset content as repaired by scrub 0x05CBC8. Physical meaning not established.

records.name: gate_8EDC_shadow
records.comment: Shadow of the gate byte; it decides the gate when the word is inconsistent. Written by 0x05CB1C and 0x05CBC8.

records.name: cnt_inc_block_ACF6
records.comment: 1 blocks the CNT increment in 0x05B73C. Set to 1 only by 0x0914AE; no resolved store clears it.

records.name: boot_window_flag_BFA8
records.comment: byte; (BFEC == 0x55), written only when the boot window runs

records.name: boot_ring_wr_index
records.comment: word; mod 100, 0 at reset (0x00054A, 0x0004D6)

records.name: boot_ring_rd_index
records.comment: word; mod 100, 0 at reset (0x00054A, 0x000524)

records.name: boot_marker_BFFC
records.comment: long 0x5AA5A55A written by 0x000756 on every boot-block exit; gates only the message window
